title: The 11 Best Instant Pots and Electric Pressure Cookers
h1: The 11 Best Instant Pots and Electric Pressure Cookers
metaDescription: Our 11 picks for instant pots and electric pressure cookers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at instant pots and electric pressure cookers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart brushed stainless steel insert, 7-in-1 functions: pressure cook, slow cook, rice, sauté, steam, warm, yogurt, 14 built-in smart programs.
strengths: Recipe compatibility is unmatched, the vast majority of published Instant Pot recipes are timed for this exact model
Sauté function browns meat directly in the insert before pressure cooking, skipping a separate pan
Yogurt mode doubles as a bread-proofing and fermentation setting most buyers don't expect
Replacement parts (sealing rings, inner pots) are cheap and sold everywhere due to the model's popularity
limitations: Dial-and-button interface feels dated next to the Pro's touchscreen
Sealing ring absorbs odors from garlic- and curry-heavy cooking within a few months
No custom program memory, so repeat recipes must be re-entered each time
Steam release is loud enough to startle anyone not expecting it
features: 7-in-1 functions: pressure cook, slow cook, rice, sauté, steam, warm, yogurt
10 proven safety mechanisms including lid lock and overpressure protection

products.name: Instant Pot DUO60 6-Quart 7-in-1 Multi-Use Programmable Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart stainless steel insert, 7-in-1 functions including pressure cook, slow cook, and sauté, 14 smart programs.
strengths: Same core sealing ring and float valve mechanism as the current Duo, so recipe timing carries over exactly
Sauté function browns onions and meat without dirtying a second pan
limitations: Discontinued as Instant Pot's flagship, so stock is inconsistent and sometimes sold as refurbished-adjacent old inventory
No yogurt starter temperature preset on some early production runs, unlike the current Duo
Same loud steam release and dated dial interface as the rest of the Duo line
Sealing ring wears out around 12 to 18 months of regular use and needs separate replacement
features: 7-in-1 functions including pressure cook, slow cook, and sauté
Original Duo lid and sealing ring design

products.name: Instant Pot Pro 10-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart stainless steel insert, 10-in-1 functions with custom program memory, Quieter steam release valve than the Duo line.
strengths: Quiet steam release is the single biggest daily-use improvement over the Duo, especially for evening cooking
Custom program memory lets you save exact pressure and time settings for repeat recipes instead of re-entering them
More precise pressure regulation produces more consistent results for delicate items like eggs and cheesecake
limitations: Custom program menu has a steeper learning curve than the Duo's simple dial
Still uses the same sealing ring that retains food odors over time
No touchscreen, display is digital but controls are still physical buttons
features: Quieter steam release valve than the Duo line
Digital display with more precise pressure and time control

products.name: Instant Pot Duo Crisp 11-in-1 Air Fryer and Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart stainless steel insert with EvenCrisp air fryer lid, 11-in-1 functions including air fry, broil, and dehydrate, Two-lid system: pressure lid and crisping lid.
strengths: Combines an air fryer and pressure cooker in one countertop footprint, genuinely replacing two appliances
Pressure cook then crisp in the same insert (e.g. pressure-cook then air-fry chicken wings) without transferring food
Air fryer lid produces noticeably crispier results than an oven broiler for finishing pressure-cooked meats
limitations: Two lids mean more storage space needed and more parts to lose or misplace
Air fryer basket capacity is smaller than a dedicated air fryer of similar price
Crisping lid's nonstick coating shows wear faster than the stainless steel pressure lid
features: 6-quart stainless steel insert with EvenCrisp air fryer lid
11-in-1 functions including air fry, broil, and dehydrate
Two-lid system: pressure lid and crisping lid
Reversible rack for air frying and steaming

products.name: Instant Pot DUO80 8-Quart 7-in-1 Multi-Use Programmable Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-quart stainless steel insert, 7-in-1 functions with 14 smart programs, Large enough for a whole 6-pound chicken or double-batch chili.
strengths: 8-quart capacity handles a full brisket or double recipes that overflow a 6-quart insert
Same 7-in-1 function set and recipe timing as the 6-quart Duo, just scaled up
Genuinely useful for batch cooking and meal prep for households of 6 or more
limitations: Significantly heavier and bulkier, a real consideration for lifting a full insert or storing on a shelf
Overkill and wasteful of energy for single portions or small households
Takes longer to reach pressure with a full 8-quart load, offsetting some of the time savings
Same dated dial interface and loud steam release as the smaller Duo
features: Large enough for a whole 6-pound chicken or double-batch chili
Compatible with 8-quart glass lid and steam rack accessories

products.name: Ninja OL701 Foodi 14-in-1 SMART XL 8-Quart Pressure Cooker Steam Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-quart nonstick ceramic-coated pot, 14-in-1 functions including pressure cook, air fry, steam fry, and dehydrate, SMART XL touchscreen with guided cook programs.
strengths: TenderCrisp lets you pressure cook and air-crisp in the same pot without swapping lids or vessels, unlike the Duo Crisp's two-lid design
Touchscreen with guided programs is noticeably more intuitive for first-time pressure cooker users than Instant Pot's dial interface
Nonstick ceramic coating means less scrubbing after sauté-heavy recipes than Instant Pot's stainless insert
limitations: Recipes must be time-adjusted from Instant Pot recipe cards since Ninja's pressure curve differs slightly
Nonstick coating wears faster than stainless steel over years of heavy use and eventually needs pot replacement
Bulkier footprint than an equivalent Instant Pot due to the steam fryer lid mechanism
Smaller third-party accessory ecosystem than Instant Pot's inserts, racks, and glass lids
features: 14-in-1 functions including pressure cook, air fry, steam fry, and dehydrate
SMART XL touchscreen with guided cook programs

products.name: Instant Pot Duo 7-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker 8-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-quart stainless steel insert, 7-in-1 functions with 14 smart programs, Large enough for a whole 6-pound chicken or double-batch chili.
strengths: Handles portions for 6 or more without a second cooking session, the clearest reason to size up from 6-quart
Same recipe compatibility as every other Duo model, just scaled for volume
Batch cooking soups, stocks, and beans for the week is genuinely more efficient at this size
limitations: Countertop footprint and storage weight are a real burden in smaller kitchens
Minimum liquid requirements mean small single-serving recipes don't work well in this size
Longer preheat time to reach pressure with a full load reduces some of the time savings
features: Large enough for a whole 6-pound chicken or double-batch chili
Compatible with 8-quart glass lid and steam rack accessories

products.name: Breville Fast Slow Pro Pressure Cooker BPR700BSS
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart brushed stainless steel housing and insert, Fast and slow cooking modes with independently adjustable pressure, LCD display with programmable timer.
strengths: Build quality and stainless finish feel noticeably more premium than Instant Pot's plastic-and-steel housing
Independently adjustable pressure levels give more control for delicate recipes than Instant Pot's fixed high/low
Sear function browns directly in the pot with better heat distribution than the Duo's sauté mode
Backed by Breville's stronger customer support and warranty reputation versus Instant Pot
limitations: Smaller third-party recipe ecosystem since most online pressure cooker recipes target Instant Pot timing
Bulkier housing takes up more counter and cabinet space than the Duo
features: 6-quart brushed stainless steel housing and insert
Fast and slow cooking modes with independently adjustable pressure

products.name: Cuisinart CPC-600 6-Quart Electric Pressure Cooker
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart brushed stainless steel housing, Browning/sauté function plus pressure and slow cook modes, Dishwasher-safe nonstick cooking pot.
strengths: Nonstick cooking pot cleans up faster than Instant Pot's bare stainless insert after sticky or starchy recipes
Delay start timer is a genuinely convenient function for prepping dinner in the morning
Cuisinart's brand reputation for small kitchen appliances gives buyers confidence outside the Instant Pot ecosystem
limitations: Fewer built-in functions than the Duo Plus or Pro at a similar price point
Sealing ring and gasket replacements are harder to find than Instant Pot's widely stocked parts
Pressure release valve is reported by some owners as less reliable over 2+ years of use
features: Browning/sauté function plus pressure and slow cook modes
Digital display with delay start timer

products.name: Instant Pot RIO Wide Plus 60oz Electric Pressure Cooker 6-Quart
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart wide, shallow stainless steel insert, 7-in-1 functions including pressure cook, slow cook, and sauté, Wider base than standard Duo for better sauté surface area.
strengths: Wider, shallower insert gives more surface area for browning multiple pieces of meat at once, unlike the taller narrow Duo
Same core function set as the Duo, so recipe compatibility carries over with minor liquid-level adjustments
Easier to fit larger flat items like whole fish or a rack of ribs than the standard tall insert
limitations: Wide, shallow shape holds less vertical capacity than a same-quart standard Duo for tall stockpot-style cooking
Fewer third-party accessories (springform pans, steamer baskets) are sized for the wide format
Newer design means a smaller base of community recipesspecifically for this insert shape
Slightly lower rating than the standard Duo suggests some early production inconsistency
features: 7-in-1 functions including pressure cook, slow cook, and sauté
Wider base than standard Duo for better sauté surface area

products.name: Instant Pot Max 6-Quart Electric Pressure Cooker with Sous Vide
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-quart stainless steel insert, 9-in-1 functions including sous vide, pressure can, and sterilize, 15 PSI max pressure, higher than the Duo's 11.6 PSI.
strengths: 15 PSI max pressure is meaningfully higher than the Duo's 11.6 PSI, cutting cook times further on tough cuts like oxtail
Pressure canning function is a genuine differentiator, most Instant Pot models explicitly warn against home canning
Sous vide mode with tighter temperature control suits precision cooking better than the Duo Plus's sous vide setting
limitations: Higher pressure requires more caution with liquid levels and food type, less forgiving for pressure-cooking beginners
Discontinued/limited availability compared to the actively produced Duo line, so parts sourcing is harder
Pressure canning still isn't USDA-endorsed for all low-acid foods, so serious canners may prefer a dedicated canner
features: 9-in-1 functions including sous vide, pressure can, and sterilize
15 PSI max pressure, higher than the Duo's 11.6 PSI
Precise temperature control for sous vide accuracy
Pressure canning function for low-acid foods

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
